---
title: "Week 0 — Base Environment Test"
output: html_document
---

Validates that R can read all core data sources in the MOATY project.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
library(readr)
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)

# Locate project root by walking up from getwd() until we find .git
find_project_root <- function(path = getwd()) {
  path <- normalizePath(path, mustWork = FALSE)
  for (i in seq_len(10)) {
    if (dir.exists(file.path(path, ".git"))) return(path)
    parent <- dirname(path)
    if (parent == path) stop("Cannot find project root (.git not found)")
    path <- parent
  }
  stop("Cannot find project root (.git not found)")
}
DATA <- file.path(find_project_root(), "data")
```

## Financial Indicators (2014)

```{r financial-indicators}
fin <- read_csv(file.path(DATA, "financial_indicators", "2014_Financial_Data.csv"),
                show_col_types = FALSE)
cat("Shape:", nrow(fin), "rows x", ncol(fin), "cols\n")
cat("First 8 columns:", paste(names(fin)[1:8], collapse = ", "), "\n")
head(fin[, 1:6], 3)
```

## XBRL Submissions — 2017q1

```{r sub}
sub <- read_tsv(file.path(DATA, "quarter_reports", "2017q1", "sub.txt"),
                col_types = cols(.default = "c"), show_col_types = FALSE)
cat("Shape:", nrow(sub), "rows x", ncol(sub), "cols\n")
glimpse(sub[, 1:8])
```
